title: The City of Brass
author: S. A. Chakraborty
summary: Nahri survives as a con artist in eighteenth-century Cairo, until a ritual she thinks is a trick summons a djinn warrior. He takes her to Daevabad, a hidden city where old feuds and royal politics are waiting. First in the Daevabad trilogy.
readIf: you like fantasy built on dense politics, rival peoples and a richly drawn Middle Eastern setting.
skipIf: you want a fast-moving plot, since the first half spends a lot of time on court intrigue and world detail.

pairings.reason: A standalone epic with several cultures, a strong political thread and a similar large-scale sweep.
A newcomer thrown into a royal court full of dangerous relatives and ancient secrets.
Another young-adult fantasy of oppression and rebellion, with a faster pace and younger leads.
